Added: Search now stays within the active sidebar catalogue, including Movies, TV Shows, anime selections and Audiobooks. Searching from Discover includes all categories.
Search headings and input hints show the active scope. Clearing a search returns to the same catalogue.
Fixed: Audiobook searches now submit the entered query instead of reloading the audiobook browse page.
Search results are filtered using returned or previously saved content metadata before any catalogue-context labels are applied.

Added: Added current-show or audiobook artwork to the playback notification and media session, enabling artwork backgrounds on supported Android/One UI media controls.
Uses the title banner when available, with the show or book cover as fallback.
Changed: Artwork loads in the background without delaying playback and stays with the playback service while the app is minimized or the phone is locked.
Switching titles clears old artwork; late image responses are ignored after a source change or Stop. Existing playback controls are retained.

Added: Added Remove on Continue Watching show cards and inside each saved show. Removal hides the show from that list while keeping watch history, watched status and resume positions.
Added Undo removal for the last removed show. Starting an episode from a hidden show again also restores it to Continue Watching.
Changed: Continue Watching removals persist on this device when the app is reopened.
Fixed: Missing or failed show covers in Watch History, Finished Episodes and Continue Watching now trigger a background lookup on the title page. Recovered cover links are saved for future visits.
Expanded title-page cover parsing to handle alternate image metadata and lazy poster elements.
Finished Episodes, Watch History and Continue Watching now group saved episodes by show instead of displaying a flat episode list.
Changed: Show cards use the same responsive poster grid as search results. Tap a card to view that show’s saved episodes, resume positions and watched controls.
Show titles and covers are saved with new history entries. Older history uses saved show information or a recognizable title URL when available.

Added: Added an offline Changelog in Settings and the navigation menu, with version numbers, dates and grouped changes.
Included release history back to 0.6.4 so users can review earlier fixes.
Changed: GitHub release notes now list Added, Fixed and Changed items and link to the full changelog.
The publisher checks that release notes, the GitHub changelog and the app's bundled history match before publishing.

Fixed: Removed the duplicate AnimeDubSerie option that returned an empty listing.
Redirected the old dubbed-series category to AnimeDubSeries.
Changed: Renamed anime categories to clear Dubbed/Subbed movies/series labels.

Fixed: Playback now pauses when leaving Player for the episode list, Discover, Favorites or history.
Leaving the Player screen while a source is preparing also prevents it from starting later.
Changed: Saved playback positions are retained; minimizing or locking the phone from Player still allows background playback.
Replaced the app icon with the supplied popcorn artwork.
Added proportional icon scaling, adaptive launcher shapes, safe padding and themed-icon support.
Version-only update from 0.6.5 to test in-app updating. No feature or behavior changes.

Added: Added GitHub update checks whenever the app opens or returns to the foreground.
Added Settings controls for manual checks, automatic checks, Update, Later and Skip this version.
Added background APK downloads and verification of checksum, package, version and signing certificate before installation.

Changed: Kept the video decoder output alive in the playback service while the app is minimized or locked.
Returning to Player reconnects the visible video window without recreating the decoder output, targeting interruptions on app return.
